en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a waterfront promenade and garden with palm trees in the foreground and a partial panoramic view of the city behind. A small harbor with boats lies along the left side, while low historic buildings and civic structures line the square. The caption in Portuguese at the top identifies the scene as a garden and partial view of Faro.
